headline: Phase 0 (safety net) is about 85% done. Phase 1 (Accounts module) is built, tested and installed on the live system, but switched off until you decide to turn it on. All existing modules are working normally.
live_health: Database: working (backup taken before every live change)
Existing modules (leave, attendance, projects, TA, chat and others): not affected
Debug mode on the live server switched off (security improvement)

phase0_tasks.task: Take a live database backup before any change
phase0_tasks.note: Backup taken before every release. Restore test passed: backup restored into a separate database with identical data (92 tables, 71 users, 687 tasks), then removed

phase0_tasks.task: Local test database that matches the live system
phase0_tasks.note: Live structure saved as a reusable file; new test environments build in minutes

phase0_tasks.task: On/off switch for each new module
phase0_tasks.note: Live. New modules stay hidden until switched on; tested

phase0_tasks.task: Login protection against repeated wrong passwords
phase0_tasks.note: Live and confirmed: blocks after 10 wrong tries for one user, others unaffected

phase0_tasks.task: Automatic test check on every code change
phase0_tasks.note: Running on GitHub; passes. Blocks new failures only
Done 23 Oct with backup and checks
165 tests: 125 pass, 40 were already failing; list saved so new breakage is caught

phase0_tasks.task: Safety test for every read screen of every module
phase0_tasks.note: About 90 screens checked for 3 roles (Super Admin, Team Lead, Employee) on every change; none crash

phase0_tasks.task: Login expiry (90 days) and overall request limit per user
phase0_tasks.note: Live. Nobody was logged out (no login was older than 90 days). Expired logins are cleaned daily

phase0_tasks.task: Sessions and cache moved off the database
phase0_tasks.note: Live. Lighter load on the database for every page; site checked after the change
Found a bug on live (errors every 5 minutes); fixed and released. Please confirm the dashboard shows alerts and recent activity
Needs a new sub-domain, web address (DNS) and certificate on your hosting account

phase0_tasks.task: Protect the main branch on GitHub (review required)
phase0_tasks.note: Would stop direct pushes to main; needs a decision on the team's workflow
Must not be run against the live site; will run on the test copy
Mostly biometric and leave tests written before recent changes

done_this_update: Built the whole Accounts module: payment states, approvals, budget increase, hold/terminate, sales targets, AMC list
Installed it on the live system (hidden): backup first, 5 new tables and one new role, existing data untouched
Added 8 tests; total 173, no new failures
Checked the full payment flow end to end through the real login and system on a test copy
next: Pick the Accounts person and switch the module on for a pilot
Look at the three Accounts screens together and fix anything that looks off
Staging copy and load test (needs your approval, see decisions)
Start Phase 2: Sales module (leads, project creation, sales inbox)
capacity_answer: The database will not break with 100+ users working at once. The live server is strong (24 processors, 40 GB memory). Improvements planned in Phase 0 (lighter background checks, rate limits, caching) give comfortable room for 150 to 300 users at the same time. A load test will confirm the exact number.

risks.risk: Sessions and cache were in the database

risks.action: Fixed: every signed-in user is now limited to 300 requests per minute
New failures are blocked meanwhile; review planned

risks.risk: An old unused copy of the app and its old database remain on the server
No safe place to load-test yet

decisions: Who is the Accounts person? (needed to create the Accounts user and switch the module on for a pilot)
Approve creating the staging (test) copy: needs a sub-domain, DNS entry and certificate on your hosting
Require review before merging to main on GitHub? (safer, but slows direct pushes)
Send the Sales document fields (needed for Phase 2)
How is budget per department calculated (sections x animation level)? Who can change it?
Rating formula for Project Coordinators and resources (HR approval needed)
Customer feedback questions, and who enters them
Meetings: simple request/approve, or full calendar invites?
Appreciation sharing to mail/LinkedIn: manual or automatic?
Google review count: manual entry or automatic?
Keep the old bug tracker alongside the new bug flow, or replace it?
Go-live: pilot team first, or everyone at once?

changelog.text: Phase 1 Accounts module built and installed on live (hidden). 8 new tests.
Login expiry, request limit, faster sessions/cache released to live. Backup restore test passed. Super Admin dashboard bug fixed.
Safety features (module switch, login protection) released to live and verified. Automatic checks active on GitHub.
Plan approved. Phase 0 started. Live debug mode off, live code updated, switch + login protection + automatic checks built.

phase1_intro: The Accounts module is installed on the live server but hidden. Nobody sees it until it is switched on for a pilot.
